notes: Patterns are real annual cropping patterns recorded in the Chittagong agricultural region (Shahidullah et al. 2017).
Feasibility uses sourced DAE/BRRI/BARI crop calendars; the turnaround time between crops is an assumption.

Soil and climate scores still use hand-set crop parameters that are not validated.
